action.description: The gated tool that resolves a passage for a caller (it reads the facts the applies domain names, such as the caller's plan, from the system of record). It must be a tool with an action in policy.yaml.

applies.description: The facts a passage can depend on, each with every value it can take (for example card: [adult, junior]). Every topic needs a passage in force for every combination. Default: none, so one passage per topic answers everyone.

localeFallback.description: What a caller in another locale hears when a topic has no passage in their locale. none: nothing (the answer is unavailable and a person is offered), which fails closed for regulated text. default: the default locale's passage. Default none.

maxAnswerChars.description: The longest answer a passage may have, in characters: an answer is spoken, so it is short. Default 400.

retrieval.description: How topics are nominated for a caller's words: settings only, read by the retriever.

cap.description: How many topics retrieval nominates at most. Default 8.

floor.description: The cosine similarity below which a topic found by its meaning (dense retrieval) is not nominated; a keyword match always counts. Default: the embedder's own (pnpm kb:bakeoff sweeps it).

embedder.description: The embedding model that finds topics by meaning beside their keywords (hybrid retrieval): potion-base-8M. pnpm kb:index writes its vectors of the topics' titles, keywords and example questions to kb/.index/<embedder>.json, and pnpm check holds that file to them. Default: none, so topics are nominated by their keywords alone.

documents.description: Answers from approved documents, where no topic answers: off by default.

summarize.description: on: where no topic answers a question, the line may answer it from the sections of the documents in kb/sources that a person approved for summarizing (pnpm kb:approve --document), worded by a model from the sections the decision model chose, held to them by the checks and the drift judge. A section a passage cites, and one marked summarize: false, is never summarized. Default off: only topics answer.

cap.description: How many sections retrieval nominates at most, each asked whether it says what the caller asked. Default 4.

floor.description: The cosine similarity below which a section found by its meaning is not nominated; a keyword match always counts. Default: retrieval.floor, else the embedder's own (pnpm kb:bakeoff --sections sweeps it).

retrieval.description: How sections are found for a caller's words: hybrid (the default), by their keywords and their meaning fused; dense, by their meaning alone (on a long document, keywords on common words can crowd the right section out: measure both with pnpm kb:bakeoff --sections). Dense needs an embedder: retrieval.embedder, or documents.embedder.

embedder.description: A contextual embedding model of its own for the sections (an ONNX model, run by the optional package @huggingface/transformers, which the app installs): their vectors are in an index of their own (kb/.index/<model>.json, pnpm kb:index), and the topics keep retrieval.embedder. Opt-in: the package is large, and its vectors can differ in their last digits from one machine to another, which can move a section near the floor in or out of the nominations. Default: the sections are in retrieval.embedder's index.

onnx.description: The ONNX sentence-embedding model's Hugging Face id, such as Xenova/bge-small-en-v1.5.

revision.description: The commit of the model's repository to load.

pooling.description: How its token vectors become one: the first token's (cls, for bge) or their mean. Default cls.
